messages:
ash: Pushed a tiny docs PR to clarify burst credit semantics when rate caps and tiered metering interact. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6120

leah: Nice. Customers were confused by our earlier wording that made it sound like burst credits simply bypass metering. Can you paste the proposed paragraph and any example snippets? I'll tidy tone and wire into the pricing FAQ.

ash: Added a short explainer in the PR: burst credits let short-lived traffic spikes draw from a pre-allocated bucket; they reduce throttling but do not change how units are calculated. Important note: metering still applies tier rounding and unit aggregation; burst credits only affect whether requests are allowed during a spike, not the billed units.

omar: Can we include a compact SDK snippet that shows how clients can prefer to consume burst credits vs. reject? We have `x-redwood-burst-preference: consume` hinted in runtime but never documented.

ash: Added a Node + curl example that sets the header. Node example:

```js
// prefer consuming burst credits for short spikes
await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {
    'Authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.REDWOOD_KEY}`,
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    'x-redwood-burst-preference': 'consume' // try to use burst credits rather than immediate throttle
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'redwood-l2', prompt: 'Hello' })
});
```

leah: Good — please make it explicit that this header is a request to the serving/runtime and may be overridden by org policy. Also add a short note linking to the console panel: "Billing > Usage Insights > Burst & Ratecap" (panel: Burst credit consumption).

omar: Filed RUNTIME-942 to surface the burst preference header into audit logs and to confirm whether it's honored for Dedicated customers under strict commit policies.

docs-bot: PR opened by ash: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6120 labels: docs, pricing, sdk-snippet.

leah: I'll do a quick copy pass and merge if no blockers; aim to ship before next deploy.

ash: Thanks — added a short FAQ entry and a one-line example for the SDK README. Leaving thread open for any final edits. :thumbsup:
